# True Light

This spell is not innate to any vocation, but granted to those who have collected a tear from the **Twin Eyes of Truth**.  
The first burns cold, the other burns bright, locked in eternal conflict.  

> “The sun we know is a lie. The moon we long for a fraud. 
> The mad god of creation shunned their children and now we play the part of both their jailor and their plaything”  
>
> — Aeridas, heir to nothing.  

---

> **True Light**  
> _9th-Level Legendary Evocation_  
> **Casting Time**: 1 action  
> **Range**: Self (300-foot radius)  
> **Components**: V, S  
> **Duration**: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
>
> You emit brilliant radiance that illuminates the area and burns creatures of darkness.
>
> The area is filled with bright light. Undead and fiends in the area take **8d8 holy damage** at the start of each of their turns.
>
> Creatures of your choice in the area have resistance to dark damage and advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.
